question: Should CodexBar add a first-party share-card export surface, and if so must it be redesigned around shared provider-driven presentation rather than the proposed dedicated model?
rationale: The repository's vision requires sign-off for new features and explicitly favors shared provider-driven UI, so code review alone cannot establish the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a shared redesign
options.body: Keep the sharing concept but require a provider-driven export descriptor, accurate availability states, and a tested capacity strategy before merge.

options.title: Accept the dedicated surface
options.body: Permit the separate share-card model after its concrete correctness defects and proof gap are resolved, accepting the added maintenance path.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Close the PR because social sharing is outside the intended minimal menu-bar control surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a shared redesign
recommendation.body: Keep the sharing concept but require a provider-driven export descriptor, accurate availability states, and a tested capacity strategy before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository vision assigns new-feature sign-off to project ownership, and this decision establishes a lasting UI and data-model boundary.
